$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0211-defaultunits-microns.xml (Rule 10, D-030). DefaultUnits="microns" on both layouts, and a LayoutSpecifier containing a SPACE - "FDI Target/DeviceLayout" - which is legal because LayoutId is xs:string with no pattern and the specifier is a path built from those ids. DeviceSize is 0,0 on both, which asserts a street width equal to the whole pitch rather than saying nothing. LowerLeft is present and zero: a parent-relative offset of zero is a value, not an absence.
